provider.name: fal.run OpenRouter router
provider.existingUserAuthorization: Approved course-specific synthetic evaluation content only.

pipeline: Real loopback HTTP POST /api/ai/chat through Express and the unchanged application router, rate limiter, handler, routing, retrieval, prompt assembly, fal provider adapter and response guards. Synthetic auth/account/course/entitlement fixtures and in-memory persisted conversation storage replace the production data boundary. No production DB.
outboundProjection: Only course context and evaluation messages leave the process. Transport excludes unrelated platform context and synthetic learner summaries after actual prompt assembly; tutor instructions and retrieved course material remain unchanged.
limits: Agent-authored and reviewed, not a separate human blind panel.
Actual application route uses synthetic auth/course/entitlement and in-memory sessions; production DB/auth, deployed UI and load are not tested.
Most ad outputs are local; no successful/failed live validation repair was observed.
Frozen v7 retains confirmed false failures and missed quality defects; no adjusted headline score is substituted.
Different new questions and a different regression mix prevent a paired performance comparison with Phase 10.
